messages.text: Dad has the pregame noise on already. That Polar Park clip you sent him made him think you have sources now.
It was one story wedged between a pasta reel and a bookstore post. Extremely official journalism.
If the lineup thing pops up again, send it. He is pretending he does not care but keeps asking.
Fine, but only if he stops narrating the commercials louder than the TV.
Did the portal finally show the bill for the tooth place, or is it still hiding behind three menus?
Did the portal link I sent you open, or is it making you start over again?
Did you finish the portal upload before dinner? It asked for income papers and anything that shows outside monthly help.
It showed up. The crown estimate is $840 after insurance, so I moved the follow-up out again.
It opened. I can scan Dad's new card after dinner and upload it from my laptop.
Almost. I put in the two paystubs, rent page, and bank screenshot. The other upload slots did not apply to me.
Also can I call before I pick the payment option for my class? I keep switching tabs and making it worse.
Bring the paperwork Sunday. We can at least check whether they coded it correctly.
Good. Keep the bank screenshot cropped neatly. Does it still leave you room if the dentist wants the first $400 this month?
Thanks. I also found the old work-benefit case number from those three video appointments, but the regular rate after that is the part I keep avoiding.
Call me after 7:30. We will go line by line and you can hit submit while I am on the phone.
Room, yes. Comfortable, not exactly. I would rather wait until Friday posts before I say yes to anything bigger.
Did the tuition form submit, or are you still staring at the confirmation page?
It submitted. I just read the email three more times and my jaw is doing the clamp thing.
Close that tab. One paper list for tomorrow, then dinner. The bursar office will still exist in the morning.
Okay. Budget tab closed too. I wrote only rent, books, call office.
Want to do Elm Park Saturday and then Root and Press? Their new arrivals table looked dangerous when I walked by.
Yes, but give me a spending ceiling before I start justifying every paperback with nice cover art.
Two from the sale shelf, one fancy drink, and we leave before either of us starts touching the staff-picks wall.
Deal. I also need a thinner one for my nightstand because the current brick keeps losing to the 9x9 grid.
Are you still in for Saturday class? The community room one is $6 instead of the studio drop-in.
Yes, $6 is perfect. I moved my Thursday auto-pay down to $38 and sent the bigger chunk to the blue Visa line, so I am being annoyingly exact this week.
Exact is fine. Bring tea after if you want, no cafe pressure.
Tea is safer. One weird tire noise and my whole little spreadsheet starts giving me side-eye.
Yoga is still 9:30 Saturday. Also, did you see the Crompton Collective room is hosting that city budget explainer Thursday?
I saved it. I mostly want the plain-English version of the rent filings, branch library hours, and why Chandler still has those axle-eating holes.
Practical agenda. I may go for the clinic waitlist and school building bits if work does not run late.
If you go, I will sit with you. I need someone to stop me from writing down every line item like it is a final exam.
Did you pick between the Tue/Thu night section and the online one? The Tue/Thu sounded less lonely, but also very after-work.
Still staring at it. The schedule says 6:10-8:45, and I have to send them my old transcript before the seat hold expires.
That is a lot for a weeknight, but two classes is more realistic than pretending you can do four.
Exactly. I only want enough to keep moving, especially if the management and accounting classes count from the last time.
I added dish soap and paper towels to the apartment note. Can you grab them if you stop after work?
Yes. I already have my grocery list open, so I'll add those under shared stuff.
Thanks. Also sent you the utility split for March.
I put bathroom sink under your column for tomorrow. I grabbed trash/recycling for tonight.
Got it. I'll send my half after I check the sheet tonight.
Thanks. I saw the magnet paper when I came in. I'll do sink and counters after work.
Also sent the March request: 900 for the place, 43.60 National Grid, 31.49 Spectrum.
Got it. I'll send tonight after I move my spinach and eggs out of the top shelf.
I put the National Grid notice on the fridge. Looks like our half each is $48.30 this month.
Thanks. I’ll send mine after dinner and initial the note so we don’t both keep checking it.
Perfect. Also my sister may stop by Saturday afternoon for an hour, but I’ll keep it in the living room.
That’s fine. I’m planning a quiet night in my room after work anyway.
I sent the utility Venmo. Sorry, heat was ugly this month.
Got it. I moved a few cart things to later and kept only groceries for now.
No rush on the bathroom mat either. The old one can survive another week.
Same strategy as my black pair with the rubbed heel. Functional, just annoying by 3 pm.
Mom found that old Clark sweatshirt in the downstairs closet. Somehow still has paint on the sleeve.
That was from the hallway project Dad decided should happen during finals week.
Classic. You were doing flashcards at the kitchen table and I was pretending to help by holding tape.
You were mostly eating the snacks Mom put out. Very important crew member.
If you vanish to the Cape in July, bring me back one of those weird cranberry sodas.
Only if the little jar survives rent, the car buffer, and that registration payment first.
Translation: I get the soda in 2029.
Maybe sooner if I keep it to one night and spend most of Saturday on the beach path.
Dr. Marino's portal sent that spring reminder again. Do you want me to print the intake page before Sunday dinner?
I found the portal note and the Mass.gov sheet. I am going to ask the pharmacist which arm is smarter before my shift.
Good. Bring the card if they ask for dates. The office has been fussy about uploads lately.
Already in my bag with my insurance card. I will upload whatever receipt they give me tonight.
For that online form, the family background part should match what you usually put: Dad's Cuzzort side from the Irish/Scottish notes, my Harrington side from old Worcester and Quebec records.
Thanks. I always freeze on those boxes even though our family story is pretty plain.
Plain is fine. You were raised with the same kitchen-table talk as everyone here, plus Christmas Eve at Nana's parish and your grandfather's hymn-singing phase.
That sounds accurate. I will finish it tonight before I overthink the wording.
The city listening thing is Tuesday, right? I saw a signup table after class but did not stop.
How did the pan with rosemary and flaky salt turn out? Mine stuck to the sheet again.
I registered for the 6:30 slot. I mostly want to ask why the public dashboard is always months behind and whether outside reviewers see serious use-of-force files.
Better after I gave it more oil and ignored it for an extra half hour. The basil on the sill survived long enough to donate a few leaves.
That sounds very you: one practical question, one spreadsheet question.
That is basically a farmers' market victory. Bring me a corner after class Saturday if there is any left?

Also I am trying not to let my entire opinion be based on my tiny sample size: one Park Ave meter envelope, one 290 warning, and the time I used the business line for that confused guy outside the laundromat.
Maybe. I still have two chapters and the little crossword grid on my nightstand trying to claim first dibs.
I moved Saturday class to 9:30. Coffee after, or are you keeping that home reset block?
Coffee, but just one hour. I promised myself no laptop at the table after noon.
Fair. Also thank you for sending that lentil soup note. My focaccia survived because of you.
I almost rewrote it three times because it sounded bossy. Glad it helped.
I found the recording from last night's community panel if you still wanted to listen while making dinner.
Yes, send it. I read the library list Melissa sent, but audio is easier tonight.
Sending. Also, the neighborhood grocery/ride pool is doing another $5 match through Friday.
Perfect timing. I can do a small one after I check rent math.
Is that your kitchen speaker still on? The banjo one is fine, just checking before I start my call.
Yes, sorry. I can turn it down. It rolled into the foxes album again while I was chopping onions.
No need, it is quieter than the blender. I just wanted to know if it was coming from our place.
I saw JMAC has $10 rush seats next Friday if you get there before 6:30. Also Canal District has the early spring vendor rows Saturday morning.
That is exactly my price range. I might do yoga, grab greens and honey, then decide about JMAC once I see my checking balance.
Very practical. If you go Saturday, the sourdough woman is usually near the coffee cart.
Good, I need starter advice and maybe a tiny treat that is not a full dinner out.
If the sidewalks are not a skating rink tomorrow, Green Bean first and then the Elm Park loop?
Yes. I can do 10:15. I need a quiet hour with you and caffeine before I deal with errands.
10:15 works. I will bring the library tote in case TidePool has anything decent in the used section.
Perfect. I have one book to return and zero self-control near staff picks.
I grabbed the package from downstairs. Looks like it is from your payroll site.
Thanks. I just got off the phones and paper stacks, so I will open it after I make tea.
No rush. Also the hallway vacuum can wait until tomorrow if your 8:30 start is real again.
It is. Same desk block Monday, then I need to check whatever they mailed before the portal closes.
Utilities posted. My half is $86.40 whenever you do the usual Sunday thing.
Got it. I already made a March row for apartment stuff, so I will plug it in before the transfer.
Also I left the paper bill on the counter. Your laptop has like 9 tiny tabs open, so I did not touch it.
Those are train fare comparisons. I will move them off the kitchen table before dinner.
Can you look at the portal upload after dinner Sunday? It keeps rejecting the scan.
Yes. If you can save the notice as a PDF, I can rename it and attach it the same way I do with the patient forms at my desk.
Thank you. I knew you would have a system for it.
Probably too much of one. I spent half of Friday fixing file names, checking the log, and sending reminder emails from Outlook.
Coffee after Elm Park? Also the library has those city-office cards by the desk again.
Yes to coffee. Can you grab one for me? I keep doing the November stuff and then spacing on the tiny spring ones.
I will. Very glamorous Saturday: latte, walk, municipal reminder card.
Honestly helpful. I want to put the clerk dates in my calendar before I forget again.
Did you eat something besides crackers before you opened the portal again?
Soup is on. I closed the laptop and made the page with "actual next step" in the middle.
Good. One upload can wait until tomorrow. Make tea and do your shoulder stretches before bed.
Tea is steeping. The only real task is calling the billing office at 9, so I put that on the top line.
Bookstore still good after coffee? If you want, we can do the Elm Park loop first and make the spreadsheets wait.
Yes please. I put sneakers on instead of reopening the laptop, which feels like the correct adult choice.
A rare and noble adult choice. Same two laps as last time?
Two laps, then coffee. I also need to do the 18-minute easy piece from the spring 5K app later if my legs are not dramatic.
Are you using the oven long? I was going to heat up leftovers around 6.
Just 20 more minutes. The tray is almost done and I wiped the little soil trail off the counter.
No rush. Also your small pots by the window look better after you moved them away from the radiator.
Good, I was trying to keep that corner from looking chaotic before I make bowls for lunch.
I left the electric bill on the counter. No rush tonight, just wanted it visible before I forget.
Thanks. I was already at the table with the rent math, the QCC login, and tomorrow's check-in sheets, so it can join the pile.
That is a very exciting pile. For what it's worth, you handled three irritated patients on the phone last week better than our lead does.
I keep thinking about that. The phone stuff and forms used to make me freeze, and now I just sort the tabs and get it done.
Nora asked if you can still do the cart labels Wednesday. She said no worries if work runs late.
I can make it by 5:45 if the bus behaves. Can you put my name on the spare lanyard again?
Yes. Also your museum pass hold came in, so you can grab that before you get buried in the return stickers.
Perfect, I wanted that pass for Saturday. I'll bring the clear tape this time.
I found the old photo of us outside homeroom with the terrible 2012 hair. You look exactly like someone who would later make spreadsheets for fun.
Please bury that photo. Also if that was fall 2012, I had literally just hit the 14 mark and thought side bangs were a personality.
You were very serious about the tiny cupcake your mom brought after school.
That tracks. Same date, same dramatic reaction to frosting, just with rent now.
I sent the rent Venmo request. Yours is $1,075 again, no rush tonight.
Got it. I moved the big chunk over after Friday's ADP line cleared, so I'll accept it before bed.
Thanks. Electric posted too: $86.40 each if we keep the same split.
That puts the apartment stuff right where my March sheet expected. I already left room for groceries and the bus pass.
I moved the 6:30 mat thing back onto Thursday. My jaw has been doing that locked-up thing again.
Good. Calendar it before your spreadsheet eats the whole evening.
Priya texted that Anna is going too, so I have social pressure in a non-annoying form.
Excellent. Go fold yourself into whatever shape makes your shoulders stop living near your ears.
Aunt Denise is sending group chat screenshots again. Please tell me you did not answer the guy with the eagle profile pic.
Nope. I sent Mom the UMass Memorial page and the county clinic calendar. That is my whole contribution.
Very diplomatic. Also Dad says your arm looked sore at dinner and wants to know if you are still doing dishes Sunday.
I can do dishes. It was only tender for a day, and the pharmacist said that was normal.
Uncle Mark is already sending screenshots about the governor like it's a sport.
Please tell him I am not joining the yelling match. I like competent boring people who can pass a budget.
So your campaign slogan is 'fix the spreadsheet and stop shouting.'
Pretty much. Also I still don't want a team label on my registration, even if I usually know which side of the sheet I end up on.
You coming Sunday or are you and Rachel doing your thrilling sink-cleaning summit
Do you still have that roommate whiteboard thing or did it become one of those cursed adult spreadsheets
Mom says Sunday dinner is 5. Are you coming or are you still battling the giant grid thing
Sunday yes. Sink summit is Friday because we are very glamorous and the left basin is gross.
Paper on the fridge, very advanced technology. Tonight says vacuum hall for me, tub for Rachel.
Did the car place actually say 1k or was that the dramatic phone voice?
Coming. I am only checking whether the Bologna day would break the daily cap if I add the museum ticket.
Mom asked if she should set two plates for you or if you’re bringing anyone.
Mom says the upload button vanished again. I told her that is above my pay grade.
The printed estimate is $987 if the second part is really needed. I can do a chunk now, but not all of that cleanly.
Powerful. Are you bringing snacks Sunday or is your cabinet currently tragic
You have planned a vacation harder than I planned my last three birthdays
Just me. I’ll bring the bread if she still wants it.
Tell her not to touch the tiny blue link. I saved the PDF on her desktop last time.
Ask them to break it up. Also Mom said the form thing was just work docs?
Mine is fine. Rachel's side has those lemon yogurts and I'm not touching them.
She also said you sounded like you were doing the ten-tabs thing about school.
Birthdays are chaos. Rows are calmer.
Yeah, work docs and bank page. Nothing else for me to add. I am calling tomorrow to ask about two payments before I touch the card.
Accurate. I am calling her after she finishes dishes, then I will stop opening calculators.
You awake or did the tiny-number square win again?
Almost asleep. I got one corner done and three pages in, which counts as productivity after 10.
That is the most Jennifer scoreboard possible.
Better than scrolling until midnight. Also Melissa found me a used copy with margins big enough for notes.
Did you upload the new card to the dental portal, or do you want me to look at it Sunday?
I can try tonight. I only have my lunch break now, and the copier has been jammed since 9.
Bring the letter if you want. Sometimes the group number hides in the smallest print.
I will. It came with the packet that mentioned my 36-month rollover, so I want to read it twice.
Did the dentist charge clear yet? I can look at the portal Sunday if it still looks strange.
It cleared. I took the blouse and scarf out of my order and left the inserts in.
That sounds sensible for now. Bring the receipt if you want a second set of eyes.
Thanks. The inserts should get me through the long shifts without doing the bigger purchase yet.
Did the dental office portal show the estimate yet? I can look at it Sunday if the upload is confusing.
It says $184 if insurance processes normally. I put it in the sheet but I hate that it lands the same week as the Capital One push.
Bring the paperwork. We can check what is due now and what can wait.
Thanks. I kept the school portal at $41 this month so there is still room if the estimate changes.
That community yoga post changed the drop-in fee again. Did you see it?
Yes, I saved the event so I don't forget. I also put the $8 in my March tab before I talk myself into skipping it.
Efficient. I only noticed because someone commented about mats being limited.
I saw that too. I'll check the post Saturday morning before I leave.
Leaving early, kitchen light is off and rent receipt is on the counter.
Thanks. I will tuck it in the folder before I go. I have to print two Word letters before the first visitor comes in.
Very front desk of you.
It follows me home. Yesterday I had three windows open: letter template, appointment calendar, and the client lookup screen.
Can you leave the parking spot closest to the curb open tonight? My cousin is dropping off the borrowed vacuum.
Yes. I may be ten minutes late anyway; I want to stop at the Main branch and print the housing packet before the comment deadline.
No rush. The kitchen light is also flickering again, which feels thematically appropriate for all paperwork.
Of course it is. I am adding the bus detour map and the school clinic flyer to the same folder so my bag can become a filing cabinet.
Rent Venmo went through. Also your mail from SmileCare is on the table.
Got it. I am not opening that envelope tonight because I already know it is another estimate.
Fair. You left your laptop on that appointment-fee page too, just so you know.
Thanks. I was checking whether the person from the work benefit has a cheaper evening slot somewhere else.
Kitchen light still on. Are you leaving the spreadsheet up for tomorrow?
I keep adding tiny categories to March like it changes the total. Also reread my advisor email twice.
Want tea? I can clear the table while it steeps.
Tea would help. I am trying to unclench my face and stop making another list.
Mom said you fixed the portal thing again. Family IT crown remains yours.
It was two buttons and one PDF. I still managed to call myself ridiculous for missing the upload tab.
You would never say that to Mom if she missed it.
Annoyingly correct. I made the checklist clearer for next time, at least.
Mom is already warming up for Sunday dinner discourse lol. I sent her that short explainer so we don't do the cable-news loop again.
Mom says you are bringing the banana thing Sunday. Is it the good one with the crunchy top?
Thank you. I listened to the interview you sent too. It helped me have actual words instead of just getting tense.
Only if the brown bananas stop looking tragic by tomorrow. I also promised myself I would finish this puzzle before I touch the oven.
So yes, but with extra steps. Save me an end piece.
Also my coworker posted a court support link. No pressure, just figured you'd want to see it.
End piece tax depends on whether you help Dad clear plates.
Send it. I can't do much, but I can probably spare $10 before payday.
Are you eating here Sunday, or is Melissa doing one of those skillet dinners with you?
Melissa and I are cooking at my place tomorrow. Sunday I can come by after 4 if that helps.
That works. Tell her I said hello, and do not let dinner become crackers over the sink.
The Elm Park event flyer has the same font as that guidance-office poster we stared at junior year.
The Hanover balcony has a few $18 seats for Sunday afternoon. I also found the Worcester Common maple weekend flyer at the library desk.
The one by the lockers? I can still picture waiting there for Brian after the late bus.
Sunday afternoon is easier than a late night. Send me the flyer? I want maple candy but not a whole crowded day.
Yes. And your mom calling at 5:30 sharp to ask whether you two were on your way.
Sending. The flyer says vendors until 2, music at noon, and the cheap balcony seats disappear fast.
I will look after work. If the seats are still there, I can make it my one fun thing this week.
Dinner timing was not a suggestion in our house.
Mom found that genealogy folder again. Prepare for the annual lecture on Cuzzorts, Harringtons, and why Nana kept every baptism card since 1973.
Honestly useful timing. I had another form asking family background and what we spoke at home growing up.
Answer: Worcester, casseroles, Dad yelling at the Sox, and Grandma making us memorize table manners.
Shockingly, the dropdowns were less colorful than that.
Do you still want me to save the AAA booklet from the office lobby? It has Boston and Cape pages.
Yes please. I am just collecting ideas until the May class bill posts.
That sounds sensible. The Cape page has a lighthouse walk that looks more peaceful than the shopping streets.
Do you need me to look over the upload page before dinner tomorrow? Those forms love hiding the important button.
That is exactly the kind of page I want.
Maybe. They want my high school record plus the Worcester State transcript from when I only did those few classes.
Bring the laptop. We can scan whatever is missing after salad, and you can ask about the evening plan on Monday.
Thank you. I also want to ask whether the scheduling class counts toward the admin pathway they showed me.
Coffee after Elm Park? I can bring that library events flyer, unless you are still fighting the spreadsheet.
Spreadsheet won this morning. I moved the QCC tabs into a folder called later and made myself stop comparing program pages.
That sounds less dramatic than your face probably made it. Bring the folder names to coffee if you want, not the spiral.
Deal. I did have one tiny good thing: Marisol asked me to show the new temp how I do intake packets without losing the sticky notes.
Anna grabbed the corner by the windows. Are you coming or saving your mat for Thursday?
Coming. I skipped coffee at home so I can make it there without rushing.
Nice. Slow class today, lots of floor work. Tea after if you have time?
Are you making yoga at 9, or doing your park loop first?
Yes please. I need the kind of morning where my shoulders remember they are optional.
Loop first. The 5K app has a short warm-up block today, so I am stacking it before class.
Nice. I saved you a spot near the window if you make it by 8:58.
Perfect. I already pinned the route, so I just have to follow the little blue line and not negotiate with myself.
Tea after class or are you doing the save-money walk home plan? 🙂
Walk home plan. I have $410 left in the flexible column until the 20th, and I still need groceries.
Class was packed today. Did you see the studio posted the April pass thing?
Fair. I can send you that lentil soup recipe instead of tempting you with the cafe.
Yes, I saved it. Also saved your chickpea dinner link and now my feed thinks I only want beans and calves stretches.
The cafe after class had that soft harmonica song you mentioned last time.
Are you still going downtown after yoga? I can return the plant cookbook if you want to hand it in with your stack.
Please do. March is behaving only if the regular stuff stays around $2,350.
Accurate enough. There is also a new cafe pop-up on Shrewsbury St in the same batch of posts.
Was it Casimir Pulaski Day? That one follows me around coffee shops.
Yes, I have to drop off the cookbook, pick up the museum pass, and check the signup binder before noon.
Yes, that was it. I knew you would clock it immediately.
Class was packed today. Glad you made it. Are you still doing the 7-minute sit after savasana or did Saturday errands win? 🙂
Errands almost won, but I sat in the car first and wrote the two things I can actually do before noon.
I saw that, and then somehow got a clip from the ballpark account right after. Very Worcester morning.
Efficient little Saturday circuit. Coffee after, or are you getting pulled behind the counter?
It is very specific breakfast-after-yoga weather.
That counts. Also I found the mint-fennel tea at the market if you still wanted to try it.
Only if they are short on the sorting table. Coffee still works if it's quick.
Yes please. I have the dentist message and laundry on the list, then I'm done feeding the imaginary extras.
Do you still want the tahini-lemon dressing link? It was good on my grain bowl.
Yes please. I have rice cooling and might throw in cucumber plus whatever I can clip from the sill.
Perfect. Mint works if you go light, but dill or parsley would be less bossy.
Mint is the one that keeps surviving, so I will be careful.
Dad is already ranting about that meeting clip. I am muting the family thread for my own survival.
Mom asked if you still want the usual apple thing for the Sept 14 dinner or if you are pretending to be above it now.
Absolutely not above it. I reserve the right to act embarrassed while eating two slices.
Tell him I am not trying to burn anything down. I just want the numbers posted faster and someone outside the building reading the worst files.
Good because I already told her 28 little candles would be a fire code issue.
He thinks you got radical from exactly one parking ticket lol.
Rude but logistically fair. Tell her apple is perfect.
Excuse you, I also have the grand life experience of being told to slow down near Auburn and calling the non-urgent number once because a man was barefoot in March.
Why are you liking my Sox rant at 12:30? Homework monster?
Assignment submitted at 10:48. Then I checked the grade page, loan page, and email like a revolving door.
Respectfully, the grade page is asleep. Put the phone down before you invent a fourth page.
Fair. I made a list called tomorrow list, then a second one called real tomorrow list, which is ridiculous.
Mom put up the birthday pictures and tagged half the cousins. Prepare yourself.
I saw Aunt Kathy's comment already. I muted the thread after the third notification.
Also there is a free bookshelf in that Worcester swap group if you still need one.
Send it to me? If it fits, I'll compare it with the Marketplace one I saved.
Are you coming Sunday before dinner? I can help scan those pages if the portal is being annoying.
Yes, thank you. I have the MassHealth renewal for Dad, plus the Worcester comment form about library Sundays and the Burncoat crosswalk timing.
Bring everything in one folder. We will do the renewal first so you are not juggling too many tabs.
Good plan. I also printed the school nurse staffing note because it uses the same upload page.
Coffee Saturday still works, but I vote no budget spreadsheet at the table.
Deal. I was only trying to see if I can do the $95 Tuesday slot and still keep the tooth appointment in April.
That is a very Jennifer sentence. Did the free work ones officially run out?
Yeah, three was the cap. I liked her, which makes the math more annoying.
Your scanner thing is on the kitchen table. I did not move the mail pile.
Thank you. I need it for my parents' packet before work.
Also your phone buzzed from Linda twice while you were making coffee.
That is my reminder to stop staring at the rent-date math and call her.
Landlord texted back. New lease draft says +$55 each starting May.
Okay. I can make it work, but I need to keep April boring. No surprise pharmacy, car, or dentist nonsense please.
I will wait on buying the hallway shelves then. We only need paper towels and dish soap this week.
Thanks. I just sent $190 to Capital One, so I am trying not to touch the buffer before rent clears.
Do you want me to print the insurance form, or are you using the scanner downtown tomorrow?
I'll use theirs tomorrow morning. I need to pick up the tax booklet hold anyway.
Okay. Please do not forget your ID if you are going to be at that side desk again.
It's already in my bag with the lanyard and the overdue book I keep meaning to return.
I did the short Elm Park lap before work. The pond side is finally not all mud.
Good report. Save the less-muddy version for us Saturday?
Yes. Coffee first, then the loop. I may need you to talk me out of buying three notebooks afterward.
I can talk you down to one notebook and one used paperback. I am a reasonable influence.
Still doing tea after class tomorrow or keeping it simple?
Simple. I have rent, the portal charge, and Rachel's heat Venmo all in the same stretch.
Tea at my place then. I have ginger and too much focaccia.
Perfect. Also wearing the old black pair again, so a shorter walk after class would be kind.
Yoga is $8 tomorrow if you register tonight. Coffee after, or are you guarding the spreadsheet again? 🙂
Registering tonight is fine. I moved the $400 dental line into March and it made the rest of the boxes look very tight.
Tea at my place after class then. Zero cafe temptation.
Perfect. I also have to send the apartment renewal packet this weekend: paystubs, checking page, and a note that the other income lines are blank.
I paid Spectrum before work. Your part is 31.49 whenever you get a minute.
Sending after my first break. I also circled recycling on the fridge paper for tonight.
Perfect. I put dish soap on there too since I bought the last bottle.
I'll pick one up with my groceries. Leaving your turkey slices alone this time, promise.
Can you leave the stove free around 7? I need ten minutes for soup before my sister gets here.
Yes. I am doing the little chocolate cups later anyway, after the counters are clear.
Thanks. Also the aloe by the sink looks thirsty if that one is yours.
Mine. I will water it when I rotate the tray.
Mom said you were making a spreadsheet for classes. Very on brand.
It has columns for tuition, books, and which nights I can still cook without becoming a pile of laundry.
Put me down as unpaid consultant for the row called 'do not take an 8am anything.'
Done. The only must-have this round is the class with purchase orders, calendars, and meeting notes. That one sounds useful at work.
If you come early tomorrow, can you bring something simple for the table? Nothing expensive.
I can do yogurt sauce and a pan of vegetables. I have enough green stuff on the sill to make it taste like more than it is.
Your father found the scanner folder. Thank you for naming everything so clearly.
Good. I kept thinking I should have done it last night instead of this morning.
I set aside the box from your old desk before your father moves the shelves.
That sounds fine. Your father will eat anything if it comes with sauce.
Is that the one with the yearbook, the city bus passes, and Brian's baseball schedules?
I may also bring the small cutting I promised you if it looks less dramatic by morning.
Yes. Also the laminated chore chart from the fridge, somehow still intact.
It was done before we needed it. That counts.
I found the small folding table in the basement if you still need one for your room.
I know. I put dinner and laundry on separate blocks today so I don't turn the whole day into one giant list.
Yes, please. The kitchen table is shared, and I’ve been trying to keep my school papers out of everyone’s way.
Please keep it aside. I want to see whether Dad really wrote "trash barrels" in all caps.
